options.name: --root
options.description: The project root directory (defaults to current directory) [default: <path>]

commands.name: build
commands.description: Build the site for production (static site generation)

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Skip the incremental build cache and force a full rebuild [default: False]

commands.name: dev
commands.description: Start the development server with live reload

options.name: --port
options.description: The port to listen on (0 = use config or default 4321) [default: 0]

options.name: --write-dist
options.description: Write all pages and assets to the output directory after each rebuild (useful for AppHost or external static file servers) [default: False]

options.name: --port
options.description: The port to listen on (0 = use config or default 4321) [default: 0]

commands.name: new
commands.description: Create a new Atoll project from a template

options.name: --template
options.description: The template to use: empty, starter, blog, or portfolio (defaults to starter) [default: starter]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: The name of the new project (also used as the directory name)
